events.name: Border War Erupts
events.flavor: Conflict diverts labs to war work. Everyone races harder; military contracts pay.

events.name: Alien Trade Routes Open
events.flavor: New artifact sources and beacon contracts. Early adapters gain market daily.

events.name: Market Crash
events.flavor: A liquidity crisis stalls every lab. Rival advances slow across the board.

events.name: Research Boom
events.flavor: A funding flood lifts the whole field — you most of all if you keep publishing.

events.name: Ethics Scandal
events.flavor: A rival's leak scandal triggers regulation. Research slows; your funding takes a hit.

events.name: Labour Strikes
events.flavor: Technician strikes idle rival facilities. Your smaller team is less affected.

events.name: Open Science Breakthrough
events.flavor: A public breakthrough accelerates everyone. Publishers gain; hoarders scramble.

events.name: Deep Signal Detected
events.flavor: A structured carrier from deep space. Relay contracts appear; rivals retool to listen.

events.name: Cryogenic Bloom Season
events.flavor: A season of anomalous cold snaps. Cryo work flourishes; vault contracts open.

events.name: Global Research Summit
events.flavor: The field meets to share notes. Publishers are rewarded; secrecy looks shabby.

events.name: Supply Embargo
events.flavor: Export controls choke instrument supply. Everyone slows; your stockpile takes a hit.
